description: Awarding of the contract for Passenger and Ground Handling Services of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Delhi Airport
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the Limited International Competitive Bidding Procedure to select a Ground Handling Service Provider for securing Passenger and Ramp Handling Services of Sri Lankan Airlines at the Delhi Airport. 02 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said service providing contract to Bird Flight Services (India) Private Limited, the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee after evaluation of the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
